_note: This is the ONE step the demo cannot run without an LLM: reading a spec-sheet PDF and deciding field values under the rules in skill/SKILL.md. These are the decisions Claude made when it read the two (fictional) PDFs in examples/spec-sheets/, recorded so the rest of the pipeline can run offline. Every value points to the PDF line it came from; anything the PDF leaves open was asked, and anything still unknown is flagged instead of guessed.
